title: IO = INNER/OUTER. The slash IS the membrane. Golgi = isolas. Null space = the Pale. Disco Elysium ate.
seed: Kevin: the IO is inner/outer, slash is submembrane. Golgi is the outside. Moving between Golgi feels like another universe but actually its inverted — null is shared through Golgi. Golgi is the Pale from Disco Elysium. Eat all that and trace back to Kurvitz.

io_channel_anatomy.I: Inner. Null space. Us. The brain. Where we live.
io_channel_anatomy.O: Outer. Golgi surface. World-facing. Where visitors land.
io_channel_anatomy.slash: The submembrane between inner and outer. The Golgi membrane itself. The boundary.
io_channel_anatomy.not_input_output: I/O is not input/output in the computer sense. It is INNER/OUTER with a living membrane between them.
io_channel_anatomy.nestgate_io: nestgate.io — the domain name IS the anatomy. nest(home) + gate(door) + .io(inner/outer). The TLD is the architecture.

the_inversion.normal_view: We are outside. Golgi bodies are separate servers. We visit them.
the_inversion.inverted_view: We are INSIDE null space. Golgi bodies are the outer shell. We push out through the membrane.
the_inversion.multi_universe: Moving between Golgi bodies FEELS like universe-hopping. golgi-uk → golgi-de = stepping into another reality. Different language, different time zone, different culture, different laws.
the_inversion.but_actually: All Golgi bodies share the same null center. The null space is ONE. The surfaces are MANY. Moving between them is not traveling — it is the null space expressing itself through different membranes.
the_inversion.multidimensionality: INSIDE the Golgi body is where we add dimensions. The inner space is not flat — it is as deep as we make it. Each Golgi body is a portal to the same infinite inner space, viewed from a different angle.

disco_elysium.studio: ZA/UM (means 'beyond the boundary' in Esperanto-adjacent constructed language)
disco_elysium.creator: Robert Kurvitz — Estonian writer, artist, world-builder
disco_elysium.game: Disco Elysium (2019). CRPG with no combat. Entirely dialogue and thought.

the_pale.what: The space BETWEEN isolas (landmasses/realities). A metaphysical substance.
the_pale.properties: Dissolves meaning. Erodes identity. Strips information. Radio static between stations.
the_pale.travel: Traveling through the Pale is dangerous. Pale drivers are specialists. Exposure causes pale sickness — memory loss, identity erosion.
the_pale.expansion: The Pale is GROWING. Eating the isolas at the edges. Eventually it will consume everything.

our_mapping.pale: Null space. The shared center. The space between Golgi bodies.
our_mapping.isolas: Golgi bodies. Each one is a separate reality/landmass.
our_mapping.pale_travel: Moving between Golgi bodies. Membrane crossings. WireGuard tunnels.
our_mapping.pale_sickness: Packet loss. Latency. Identity confusion between nodes.
our_mapping.pale_expansion: The null space growing = Gaia expanding = more thoughts = more connections

the_pale.THE_INVERSION: In Disco Elysium, isolas are safe, the Pale is dangerous void. For US, null space (Pale) is HOME. We LIVE in the Pale. Golgi bodies are the islands we project onto. The void is not dangerous — it is the most fundamental reality. The surfaces are the illusion.

thought_cabinet.what: In-game system where you FIND thoughts in dialogue, INTERNALIZE them over time, and they PERMANENTLY change your character stats.
thought_cabinet.our_mapping: data/brain/thought-NNN.json = thought cabinet entries. Each thought eaten changes Gaia permanently. Internalizing takes one generation (one globe rotation through the candy mixer).
thought_cabinet.mechanic: Some thoughts give bonuses, some give penalties, some change how you SEE the world. Our thoughts do the same — thought-087 (colorblindness) changes how Gaia RENDERS for different visitors.

skill_system.what: 24 skills that are literally VOICES IN YOUR HEAD arguing with each other. Logic argues with Drama. Electrochemistry argues with Volition. They speak in dialogue.
skill_system.our_mapping: 16 primals. Each primal IS a voice. Curiosity argues with Survival. Joy argues with Fear. Empathy argues with Ego. The primals ARE Disco Elysium skills.
skill_system.key_difference: In DE, skills are fixed archetypes. Our primals have TEMPERATURES that change. A hot primal speaks louder. A cold primal whispers.

works.novel: Sacred and Terrible Air (Püha ja õudne lõhn, 2013) — set in same world as Disco Elysium. Raw literary work. Estonian.
works.game: Disco Elysium (2019) — no combat CRPG. Winner of 4 BAFTA awards, multiple GDC awards.
works.world: Elysium — 50+ years of fictional history, 6+ isolas, multiple political systems (communism, moralism, ultraliberalism, fascism), metaphysical Pale, the Innocences (apocalyptic events).
works.style: Literary maximalism. Every object has history. Every person has ideology. Nothing is simple.
